title: Apple Inc (AAPL) Stock Price & News - Google Finance

knownGaps.why: Genuine limitation. A quote page carries an $0.11 dividend beside a $147 billion market cap — twelve orders of magnitude. The median grid (share prices, three decimals) fits neither end.

DEFECT, not a limitation, and newly visible because this invariant did not exist until now. A figure renders as 24.5M ZEC while "$19.4..." sits in the same parent, unconverted. Every other invariant asks whether a CONVERTED price is right, so nothing here could fail for a price we simply missed - which is exactly how Apple's configurator and Amazon's headline price shipped in dollars. Recorded rather than papered over; the cause on this page is not yet diagnosed.

fiatRemainingWhy: 1 remaining, deliberate: "-$19.4 billion" is a negative figure. Refunds, declines and deductions are not prices to convert.
